title: Moser's Circle Problem - Final Rearrangement of Euler's Formula
full_prompt: Create a Manim scene named 'FinalRearrangment' that visualizes the algebraic substitution and simplification of Euler's formula for Moser's Circle Problem. Start with the formula F = E - V + 1 at the top of the screen. Introduce the expressions for V (vertices) and E (edges) as V = n + nC4 and E = nC2 + 2*nC4 + n, color-coded in TEAL and BLUE_B respectively. Animate the step-by-step substitution of V and then E into the main formula using smooth transitions (like FadeTransform). Once substituted, highlight the terms that cancel out (the 'n' terms and one of the 'nC4' terms) using a flash effect, and fade them out. Finally, rearrange the remaining terms into the simplified formula F = 1 + nC2 + nC4 using curved paths (path_arc) to make the movement of terms visually clear and elegant.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect Tex indexing during substitution causing mismatched character animations
common_failure_modes.note: Tex string parsing and indexing varies heavily between Manim versions and LaTeX engines. Hardcoded indices like top_eq3[14] are extremely fragile.
FadeTransform is native to ManimGL but not directly available in ManimCE, requiring manual ReplacementTransform or custom animation groups.
